verified: SOURCING verified dead, Aug 2026: /rss and the /jobs HTML search both return HTTP 403 to urllib even with a browser User-Agent, and the Publisher API is closed-partner only. The APPLY flow below is NOT verified first-hand - it is community knowledge. Discover every selector at runtime.
policy: Apply inside the user's OWN already-logged-in Chrome profile, at their own residential IP, one application at a time. Sourcing stays on Adzuna/the ATS APIs. NEVER: proxies, User-Agent or fingerprint spoofing, headless-flag patching, or captcha solving - the 403 above is a bot wall and the only sanctioned response to a wall is not to go through it. Enabled by default: using this channel is a risk decision each user makes; disable it (enabled=false) if you don't accept it.

rate.why: Indeed states it may limit daily applications and publishes no number; third-party 30-50/day flag thresholds have no primary source. 20 is a deliberately conservative floor on an undisclosed cap. A fixed minimum interval, no randomised jitter.
rate.on_cap: Any 'you have reached the limit', Cloudflare interstitial or captcha -> stop the Indeed channel for the day.

match.notes: jk=<id> is the dedup key. Glassdoor / ZipRecruiter / SimplyHired are deliberately NOT matched here: same posture, different DOM, and no adapter was written for them - they fall through to detect()=None -> human_queue, which is the honest answer. | 2026-08-23 VERIFIED: id/data-testid on the apply button are per-posting random 60-char hashes - never match on them. Search cards are [class*=job_seen_beacon] with [data-jk]; there is NO h2 in a card (title = first line of card innerText). [data-testid=company-name] and [data-testid=text-location] are still valid. Result pages contain decoy cards with synthetic jk values (cdef0123456789ab, 789abcdef0123456, f1e2d3c4b5a67890) - do not use those as dedup keys.

apply_url.note: No URL rule. The Apply control is a JS handoff that either opens the SmartApply flow (smartapply.indeed.com / an #ia-container iframe) or leaves Indeed for the employer's real ATS - preflight_js decides which.

preflight_js.why: Tell Indeed Apply from 'Apply on company site', and get the form to top level so refs work.

on.NAVIGATE:<url>: navigate there so the form is top-level, then re-run preflight
on.RECHECK: the apply flow opened - re-run preflight to resolve which shape it took
on.EXTERNAL: not an Indeed application: follow it, re-run adapters.detect() on the landing URL and re-plan with that adapter. Do not count it against the Indeed rate.
on.NO_APPLY_BUTTON: human_queue - expired posting or a layout this file does not know

gate.detect_js: (async()=>{const t=document.body.innerText||'';if(/just a moment|checking your browser|attention required|cf-browser-verification/i.test(t)||document.querySelector('#challenge-form,iframe[src*=challenges.cloudflare]'))return'BOT_WALL';if(/verify you are human|unusual traffic|are you a robot/i.test(t))return'BOT_WALL';if(document.querySelector('input[name=__email],#login-email-input,form[action*=account/login]'))return'SIGN_IN_REQUIRED';return'ok'})()
gate.why: Indeed fronts the whole property with bot management and requires an account to apply. Both are human-only.
gate.hard_rule: NEVER type the Indeed password, never solve the Cloudflare or captcha challenge, never retry through it from a different address. On BOT_WALL stop the Indeed channel for the day and tell the user.
gate.resume_after: The user signs in themselves in that tab; then re-run preflight.

fields_note: Empty on purpose. Nothing in the SmartApply flow has a selector this project has verified, and writing plausible-looking ids would be a lie the readback could not catch. Everything comes from runtime discovery; contact fields map through answer_rules' name/email/phone rules.

flow.shape: SmartApply: contact -> resume (stored resume cards, or the Indeed-hosted resume) -> employer screening questions -> review -> submit. Step count is per-employer.
flow.loop: Re-run question_map.discover_js after every 'Continue' - it is a step wizard and the DOM is replaced each time.
flow.resume_step: Select the existing stored/Indeed resume. Do not upload a fresh file per application.
flow.proxied: Indeed Apply frequently posts into the employer's real ATS behind the scenes; the confirmation is Indeed's, the downstream record is theirs. Expect the employer's own acknowledgement email, not Indeed's.

question_map.how: Per-step discovery, labels only. Employer screening questions here are arbitrary and often required.
typical: Full name / email / phone (prefilled from the Indeed account)
Are you legally authorized to work in <country>?
Will you now or in the future require sponsorship?
How many years of experience do you have with <X>?
Are you willing to commute/relocate to <city>?
Employer free-text screener questions (arbitrary, often required)

verify.how: Nothing is filled from a declared field list, so the readback is the discovery pass re-run plus the review step read back with get_page_text.
verify.fail_closed: Any required input still empty, any visible error, any in_shadow question, or a disabled Continue -> human_queue. Never submit unverified.

submit.gate: db.claim(uid) must return before this click - it re-checks the tier-1 gate, auto_submit and the per-company caps. Irreversible.
submit.note: Unverified selector. Confirm with read_page that the control reads 'Submit your application' - 'Continue' looks identical to a selector and is not the irreversible one.
submit.confirm: get_page_text for the 'Your application has been submitted' copy.

blockers.policy: Indeed Job Seeker Guidelines prohibit third-party bots and automated tools for applying, and name account closure as the consequence. Running the channel is each user's own risk decision, not a licence to disguise the automation.
blockers.http: 403 on every unauthenticated path with a browser User-Agent - sourcing via HTTP is dead. Discovery comes from Adzuna and the ATS APIs; this adapter only applies to a posting someone else found.

cloudflare.type: bot management in front of the whole property
cloudflare.on_challenge: human_queue and stop the channel for the day
cloudflare.never: No proxies, no UA or fingerprint spoofing, no solver.

blockers.login: Indeed account required to apply. The user signs in; the agent never types the password.
blockers.external_redirect: 'Apply on company site' leaves Indeed for the real ATS. preflight returns EXTERNAL; re-detect and hand off - and note the same posting probably already arrived from Greenhouse/Ashby/Lever, so check the dedup hash before applying twice.
blockers.iframe: SmartApply often renders in an #ia-container iframe; navigate to the frame's own src so refs are top-level.

alternative.why: Sourcing only. Public API with a free registered key, ~250 calls/day, clean JSON with stable ids and created timestamps - the sanctioned way to get broad-market inventory that Indeed's 403 denies. Belongs in discover.py, not here.
alternative.not_a_substitute_for: Elite quant roles - Adzuna will not surface those.

do_not_touch.why: Captcha token fields. Writing to one is a bypass attempt - out of scope, permanently. Detection only; a visible challenge is human_queue.
Bot wall. Detect, stop, tell the user. Solving or bypassing it is out of scope, permanently.
Credential entry is a prohibited action. The user signs in.
Use the stored Indeed resume. A fresh upload per application adds a signal and gains nothing.

resume_policy: Indeed applies with the resume STORED on the user's Indeed profile - do not upload from docs/variants/. input[type=file] stays on do_not_touch. If the stored resume is stale, that is a human task, not an upload.
